description: This file defines utility functions for MIME type handling, including functions to check if a MIME type is JSON or textual, and to get MIME types based on file extensions. It also contains a comprehensive map of file extensions to MIME types.

methods.name: isJsonMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a given MIME type string matches JSON MIME types.

methods.name: isTextualMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a given MIME type string matches textual MIME types.

methods.name: getMimeTypeForPath
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given file path based on its extension, or null if unknown.
